compiled_state.title: Update project docs to reflect F7b defense pipeline proximity enforcement and relation validation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update reference docs to reflect that cited_lines proximity matching and relation/escape_rationale enforcement are now active, not merely defined.

**Why**: Stories A and B activate schema fields and behaviors (cited_lines in defense records, relation-based novelty gate) that are currently described in docs as specified but not enforced. After shipping, the docs will be misleading without updates.

**Scope**:
- IN: Update review-findings-schema.md proximity window note from 'defined' to 'enforced by runner.py'; update review-defenses.md to document cited_lines emission in DEFENSE_RECORD format; update relation field docs to indicate runtime enforcement by runner.py
- OUT: Changes to agent prompt files (handled within Story B implementation); new ADR (existing ADR 0013 covers authority scope); changes to CLAUDE.md

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, review-findings-schema.md or the relevant contracts doc reflects that the ±5-line proximity window is now enforced by runner.py _suppress_defended_findings (not just defined in schema)
  ← Satisfies: Story A (1ef8-79c4) shipped and active
- When this story is complete, review-defenses.md documents that mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh now emits cited_lines on every DEFENSE_RECORD (behavior change from Story A)
  ← Satisfies: Story A (1ef8-79c4) shipped and active
- When this story is complete, the relation field documentation (review-findings-schema.md or contracts) indicates that runner.py validates relation + escape_rationale for cycle ≥ 2 NEW_INTRODUCED findings (activated by Story B)
  ← Satisfies: Story B (0b1b-8177) shipped and active
- When this story is complete, no reference doc still describes the proximity matching or relation enforcement as future/planned behavior

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Apply doc-router.md gates before writing — Gate 2 (reference content) is the primary target; do NOT write to CLAUDE.md directly

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
